founder.heading: Hi, I'm Mahima.
paragraphs: For six years I've brought sound healing, breathwork and mindful movement into workplaces across Gurgaon and Delhi-NCR. The aim is simple: help people put down the pressure they carry and leave with a few tools they actually use.
Every session I run myself, so the room stays personal. It is never a franchised script.

image.alt: Mahima, sound healing facilitator, standing beside her singing bowls

items.question: How large a team can join one session?
items.answer: 10–80 people works well. Above 80 we split into two sittings or add a co-facilitator so the sound still reaches everyone.

items.question: Our team is sceptical. Will this feel awkward?
items.answer: We keep it grounded: no chanting, no forced sharing. It's guided breathing, Tibetan bowls and rest. Sceptics usually leave the calmest.

items.question: Is it tied to any religion?
items.answer: No. It's a secular, nervous-system reset. Nothing devotional, nothing anyone needs to believe in.

items.question: How long is a session?
items.answer: The standard stress reset runs 75 minutes. Half-day and full-day formats are available for offsites and retreats.

items.question: On-site, studio or online?
items.answer: We come to your office anywhere in Gurgaon and Delhi-NCR, host at a partner studio, or run a guided online version for hybrid teams.

items.question: What do we need to provide?
items.answer: A quiet room where people can sit or lie down, and 45 minutes of setup access. We bring bowls, mats and audio.

items.question: Is it safe for everyone?
items.answer: For most people, yes. Anyone who is pregnant or has epilepsy, a pacemaker or a serious medical condition should check with their doctor and tell us beforehand. We share a short screening note with your team in advance.

items.question: How is it priced and invoiced?
items.answer: Quoted per session by team size, location and format, with a fixed number in writing before you commit. We invoice with GST and can work with your PO process.

items.question: What notice do you need?
items.answer: Usually 5–7 days. Rush dates are often possible, so ask.

enquire.heading: Tell us about your team.
enquire.body: Send your team size, preferred dates and office location. You get a written proposal and fixed quote within one working day.
